# implement-spec ledger — P14.1 the public read API

- **spec:** docs/tickets/P14.1__public-api.md (canonical §37)
- **base commit:** ea8fdc6c48637e7e74a925e53060f0871e00c283 (P13.2)
- **branch:** devin/p14-1-public-api
- **base_branch:** devin/p13-2-policy-legal (stacked chain)

## Requirements (from §37 + ticket)
- SIG-API-001 hand-written, versioned contract (FastAPI+OpenAPI, never schema reflection)
- SIG-API-002 full resolution envelope on every material fact; never a bare value
- SIG-API-003 per-response coverage statement (§32.2)
- SIG-API-004 collection licence statement (§42.4) + entity upstream attribution (SIG-CONTRIB-020)
- SIG-API-005 every read endpoint accepts+echoes as_of_world/as_of_belief; never implicit latest
- SIG-API-006 cacheable by full as-of pair; belief-pinned long-cache, now-pinned not
- SIG-API-007 REST/OpenAPI baseline; resource families (entity/claim/resolution/evidence/dossier/search/task/coverage/contradiction/crosswalk/export/changes)
- SIG-API-008 /id/{type}/{uuid} dereferenceable, content-negotiated HTML/JSON-LD/RDF
- SIG-API-009 /changes feed driven by snapshot-diff (§29.7)
- SIG-API-011 tiers anonymous/registered/partner; none grant restricted/sealed
- SIG-API-012 prohibited-endpoint bar: no device-liveness, per-person lookup, sealed bytes, over-precise coords (§19.4)
- SIG-API-013 acceptable-use terms prohibit re-identification, state a remedy

## Acceptance criteria
- AC1 no material-fact response returns a bare value w/o full §37.1 envelope (contract test)
- AC2 both as-of params accepted+echoed; omission states resolved values, never implicit latest
- AC3 belief-pinned request reproducible after a correction (identical pre-correction result)
- AC4 no prohibited endpoint exists (SIG-API-012)
- AC5 phase-gate: CI green; new reqs tested; ADR; traceability; risk register

## Out of scope (scope-creep guard)
- Bulk exports, licence computation heavy/ODbL split, crosswalk export, Zenodo — P14.2
- GraphQL secondary surface (must NOT be only surface) — skip
- Public web surfaces — Phase 15

## Dependency map (reuse, do not reinvent)
- envelope: reconcile.resolve.RESOLVE -> Resolution (rationale split code/text)
- as-of: db.temporal.AsOf.resolve (world=today, belief=now; *_defaulted flags)
- coverage: inference.coverage.CoverageRecord.public_view()
- changes: reconcile.snapshot_diff.diff_series(Capture[]) -> FieldChangeEvent[]
- sensitivity/coords: policy.sensitivity.apply_tier/geo_tier_for/SensitivityClass
- tiers/sealed: evidence.tiers.StorageTier, public_representation, CaptureMetadata
- licence/attribution: policy.licensing.downstream_obligations/compute_export_license; policy.rights.RightsRecord

## Notes / decisions
- No DB fetch-by-id layer exists; API is a hand-written contract over a ReadStore
  Protocol with an in-memory impl. Endpoints assemble envelopes by calling RESOLVE etc.
- AC3 needs belief-time filtering: store keeps asserted_at per claim; claims_for filters
  by as_of_belief so a later correction is invisible to a past-belief-pinned request.
